subject: general
question:
A word in the following sentence is INCORRECTLY spelt. Select that word from the given options.

Life requires great sacrifices and an understanding of the duoality of the universe; this makes us happier.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"duoality"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"duality".** (द्वैतवाद)

 
 
• **Example: **The concept of duality is central to many philosophical and religious traditions.
 
 
 
• **"Duality" **refers to the quality or condition of being dual; a dual state or quality. (द्वैत)
 
 
• **Example: **The** duality **of human nature is often explored in literature.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: '**Option 2**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Understanding **(समझ): The ability to understand something; comprehension.

 
 
• **Example: **His **understanding** of quantum physics is remarkable.
 
 
 
• **Universe **(ब्रह्मांड): All existing matter and space considered as a whole; the cosmos.
 
 
• **Example: **Astronomers study the **universe** to understand its origins and structure.
 
 
 
• **Sacrifices** (बलिदान): Acts of giving up something valued for the sake of something else regarded as more important or worthy.
 
 
• **Example:** Parents often make** sacrifices **for their children's education.
